career_history.description: Owned the ranking layer for an e-commerce search product, evolving it from a hand-tuned scoring function to a learning-to-rank model over 9 months. career_history.title: NLP Engineer

career_history.title: Machine Learning Engineer

Designed the query expansion module that handles vocabulary mismatch between user queries and document terms. Reported search-relevance improvement of 35% over the prior Elasticsearch BM25 setup, validated through human relevance judgments.

Worked closely with PMs to define the optimization target (click-through vs. dwell time vs. downstream conversion) — that work was as important as the modeling itself.
